constraints.ocl:
context Payment
inv: self.amount >= 4 and self.amount <= 61

context Baggage
inv: self.weightKg >= 73 and self.weightKg <= 88

context Payment
inv: self.amount >= 13 and self.amount <= 39

context Airline
inv: self.aircrafts->any(x | x.model <> '') <> null

context Airport
inv: self.arrivingFlights->any(x | x.flightNo <> '') <> null

context BoardingPass
inv: ((self.checkIn.isOnline) and (self.barcode.size() <= 71)) and (not((self.checkIn.isOnline) and (self.barcode.size() <= 71)))

context Booking
inv: ((self.checkIn.isOnline) and (self.status <> null)) and (not((self.checkIn.isOnline) and (self.status <> null)))

context Flight
inv: (self.departureTime <> null implies self.arrivalTime <> null) and (not(self.departureTime <> null implies self.arrivalTime <> null))

context Airline
inv: (self.aircrafts->exists(x | x.model <> '')) and (not(self.aircrafts->exists(x | x.model <> '')))

context Seat
inv: ((self.aircraft <> null) and (self.aircraft.oclIsTypeOf(Aircraft))) and (not((self.aircraft <> null) and (self.aircraft.oclIsTypeOf(Aircraft))))

context Flight
inv: ((self.departureTime <> '') and (self.bookings->forAll(v | v.bookingRef <> ''))) and (not((self.departureTime <> '') and (self.bookings->forAll(v | v.bookingRef <> ''))))

context Aircraft
inv: ((self.seats->collect(x | x.seatNo)->notEmpty()) and (self.seats->size() > 0)) and (not((self.seats->collect(x | x.seatNo)->notEmpty()) and (self.seats->size() > 0)))

context Flight
inv: ((self.flightNo <> '') and (self.bookings->forAll(v | v.bookingRef <> ''))) and (not((self.flightNo <> '') and (self.bookings->forAll(v | v.bookingRef <> ''))))
